title: Climate scientists face deluge of public-records requests about fossil-fuel studies
title_zh: 气候科学家面临化石燃料研究公开记录请求的洪水
abstract: A Nature investigation identified more than 30 requests since 2024 to US universities in a campaign questioning climate attribution science.
abstract_zh: Nature的一项调查自2024年以来在质疑气候归因科学的运动中，已向美国大学发出了30多份公开记录请求。
snippet: A Nature investigation identified more than 30 requests since 2024 to US universities in a campaign questioning climate attribution science.
